summary: Read an existing Slack DM by user ID or D-prefixed channel ID with a user token, while retaining the bot-token read path for accessible DMs.
reason: A raw DM channel ID can return channel_not_found until the DM is resolved for the user. The history command must not create a new conversation or require a user token when the bot can already read the DM.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests check existing-DM lookup with prevent_creation, bot-token-first reads, user-token fallback, local-source rejection, retry errors, mutually exclusive flags, and dry-run filters without a request.
